channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: Chennai Corporation plans biogas plants in schools to cut LPG use, promote clean energy
item.description: Chennai Corporation Commissioner J. Kumaragurubaran said the civic body intends to collaborate with willing non-governmental organisations, individuals and residents’ welfare associations to implement the project.

item.title: AIIMS-led trial on most advanced brain stent shows promise for stroke patients
item.description: The trial marks a milestone for the Make-in-India initiative and positions India as a global player in advanced stroke care, the experts said.

item.title: Rain likely in Chennai, neighbouring districts till 1 pm on Dec 16
item.description: Earlier, the RMC had said that an upper air cyclonic circulation prevailing over south Tamil Nadu and adjoining areas would bring light to moderate rain with thunder and lightning at isolated places over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal today.

item.title: Wild boar menace: Farmers in TN's Theni demand implementation of shooting order to save crops
item.description: With losses mounting by the day, cultivators are pressing the Forest Department to immediately enforce shooting orders issued by the Tamil Nadu government to check the growing menace.

item.title: Russian FM slams Europe as 'quack doctor' on Ukraine issue
item.description: Likening Europe's approach to that of a "quack doctor," he said, "They only prescribe medicines that make you feel better for five minutes. They will never make a proper diagnosis."

item.title: Day to remember bravery of army, courageous leadership of Indira: Congress on Vijay Diwas
item.description: Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge hailed Indira Gandhi for her visionary leadership and said the victory became a great example of humanity and justice.

item.title: National Herald Case: Delhi court refuses to take cognisance of ED chargesheet against Gandhis
item.description: It has been alleged that they acquired properties worth approximately Rs 2,000 crore belonging to Associated Journals Limited (AJL), which publishes the National Herald newspaper.

item.title: HDFC Bank gets 1 year RBI approval for up to 9.5 pc stake in IndusInd Bank
item.description: The approval was granted through a letter dated December 15 and will be valid for one year, until December 14, 2026.

item.title: Modi govt's illegality fully exposed: Cong after court relief for Gandhis in National Herald case
item.description: In a statement, Congress spokesperson Supriya Shrinate said the ED's proceedings against Congress leadership -- Sonia Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi -- in the case have been found to be "completely illegal and malafide" by the court.

item.title: Rupee breaches 91-mark against US dollar for first time in intra-day trade
item.description: The rupee fell from 90 a dollar to 91 in the last 10 trading sessions. The local unit has slipped 1 per cent against the greenback in the past five sessions alone.
